title: Junior Digital Marketing Executive
description:
Our client is an creative marketing agency that works with a diverse portfolio of clients across multiple sectors. They are passionate about helping brands connect with their audiences through innovative digital marketing campaigns and engaging creative content.

They are seeking a Junior Digital Marketing Executive to join their team and support the delivery of exciting marketing campaigns across social media, email marketing, and digital content channels.

Role Overview

This is an excellent opportunity for a creative and ambitious individual looking to build a career in digital marketing. The successful candidate will gain practical experience across content creation, campaign delivery, social media management, and email marketing.

Working alongside experienced marketers and designers, you will contribute to campaigns that help clients increase engagement, brand awareness, and business growth.

Key Responsibilities
- Create engaging social media content for a variety of client accounts.
- Design graphics and marketing assets using Canva.
- Assist with planning and scheduling content across social platforms.
- Support the creation and deployment of email marketing campaigns.
- Monitor campaign performance and engagement metrics.
- Assist with content calendars and campaign planning.
- Conduct market and competitor research.
- Support copywriting for social media, email campaigns, blogs, and website content.
- Help maintain brand consistency across client campaigns.
- Contribute ideas for creative marketing initiatives and content strategies.

Required Skills & Qualities
- Passion for digital marketing and creative content.
- Strong written communication skills.
- Creativity and attention to detail.
- Good organisational and time-management skills.
- Ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously.
- Positive attitude and willingness to learn.

title: Marketing Co-ordinator
company: Sue Ross Recruitment Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Sue Ross Recruitment are delighted to be working with a highly successful and expanding Sheffield-based business, operating within the construction and industrial products sector, to recruit an experienced Marketing Co-ordinator.

This is an exciting opportunity for a creative, hands-on marketing professional who can confidently take ownership of content creation and digital marketing activity from day one. Working within a small marketing team and reporting directly to the Marketing Director, you will play a key role in increasing brand awareness and engagement across multiple channels.

Key Responsibilities:
- Creating engaging content for social media platforms including LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube
- Filming, editing and publishing video content
- Developing and implementing social media campaigns to drive engagement and brand visibility
- Producing marketing materials including brochures, product literature and promotional assets
- Working with sales teams to fulfil marketing collateral requests
- Monitoring campaign performance and making recommendations for improvement
- Assisting with influencer and partnership marketing activities
- Ensuring brand consistency across all marketing communications

The Successful Candidate Will Have:
- Proven experience within a marketing role, ideally with responsibility for content creation and social media management
- Strong working knowledge of the Adobe Creative Suite
- Experience of filming and editing video content for digital platforms
- Excellent copywriting and communication skills
- The ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously
- A proactive, hands-on approach with the confidence to hit the ground running
- Experience within a product-led, manufacturing, industrial or construction-related environment would be advantageous but is not essential

What's on Offer:
- Salary up to 35,000
- Full-time permanent position
- Office-based role in Sheffield
- Working hours of 8:30am to 5:00pm Monday to Thursday and 8:30am to 4:00pm Friday

Unfortunately due to the number of applications we receive, we are unable to provide individual feedback to all applicants. Please assume that if you do not hear from us within 72 hours that your application has been unsuccessful on this occasion.

May we take this opportunity to thank you for expressing an interest in one of our roles and wish you the very best in your search for employment.

title: Digital Marketing Executive (Content Creation)
description:
Our client is a growing recruitment organisation dedicated to connecting talented individuals with outstanding career opportunities across multiple sectors. They are seeking a creative and ambitious Digital Marketing Executive to support their marketing activities and strengthen their online presence.

Role overview

The successful candidate will be responsible for creating engaging digital content that attracts candidates and clients across various online platforms. This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to develop a career in digital marketing and content creation within a fast-paced recruitment environment.

Key duties
- Create engaging content for social media channels including LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram and TikTok.
- Develop written content such as blogs, articles, candidate success stories and company updates.
- Assist with email marketing campaigns.
- Create graphics, videos and promotional materials using design software.
- Monitor social media engagement and respond to enquiries where appropriate.
- Support website updates and content management activities.
- Analyse campaign performance and produce basic reports.
- Ensure all content aligns with brand guidelines and marketing objectives.

Candidate requirements
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Creative mindset with an eye for detail.
- Interest in social media, content creation and digital marketing.
- Good organisational and time-management skills.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Basic knowledge of Canva is advantageous.

title: Marketing and Communications Officer
company: Get Staffed Online Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Marketing and Communications Officer

Hours of Work: Up to 37 hours per week; Some evening and weekend work may be necessary to carry out the duties of this post

Salary: £31,063 - £32,094 (FTE)

Term of Employment: Fixed Term (18 months)

Location: Rotherham

The Marketing and Communications Officer will play an instrumental role in promoting all strands of the Moving Rotherham initiative and will lead on designing, delivering, and evaluating innovative marketing strategies to communicate project impact, grow audiences, and encourage active participation across diverse communities in Rotherham.

Main Duties and Responsibilities

1. Marketing Strategy and Brand Management:
- Devising and monitoring campaign strategies and individual project plans within defined budgets.
- Implementing an effective and engaging brand identity across all programme strands.
- Evaluating all marketing campaigns to ensure audience targets and financial targets are met.

2. Digital Communications and Content Creation:
- Managing and updating the Moving Rotherham website and digital platforms.
- Planning and creating engaging social media content across Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn.
- Producing and monitoring targeted e-newsletters.
- Supporting project documentation and evaluation commissioning film and photography.

3. Media Relations and Event Promotion:
- Serving as the key point of contact for media enquiries across local, regional, and national print, broadcast, and online media.
- Identifying opportunities with strategic networks to secure media coverage.
- Creating and implementing imaginative communications for events, festivals, and community roadshows.

4. Stakeholder Collaboration and Compliance:
- Building strong relationships with delivery partners, website providers, designers, and evaluation teams.
- Assisting members of the public via telephone and in person in a courteous manner.
- Ensuring compliance with Data Protection Act / GDPR guidelines, as well as organisational policies on Equality, Health and Safety, Corporate Image, and Confidentiality.

Our client is the lead body for supporting, developing and promoting the Voluntary and Community Sector (VCS) in the Rotherham Borough. Their role is to facilitate effective action to bring about positive change in the lives of individuals and communities in the local area.

To apply for this role, please send in your CV and a covering letter (outlining your skills and experience in relation to this role).

Closing date for applications is 5:00pm on Monday, 23rd of November.

Interviews are likely to be held on Friday, 4th of December at The Spectrum. Our client will, however, review applications as they are submitted and may bring candidates forward for an interview (with reasonable notice) at any time. They may also close this vacancy early if sufficient applications have been received.

title: Marketing Executive
description:
About the Role

Our client is looking for a creative and proactive Content & Communications Marketing Executive to join its growing marketing team. Reporting to the Marketing Manager, you'll own the company's social media, create engaging content, deliver email campaigns and coordinate events and exhibitions.

This is initially a 9-month contract, with a view to the role becoming permanent.

Key Responsibilities
- Create engaging content for social media, websites, email, case studies, blogs and marketing collateral, including graphics, photography and video.
- Manage LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook and YouTube, including the content calendar, scheduling and performance reporting.
- Plan, design and deliver email campaigns and newsletters, tracking results and recommending improvements.
- Work with the Digital Marketing Executive to update website content, landing pages and news articles.
- Coordinate exhibitions, trade shows and company events, including stand graphics, logistics and promotion.
- Maintain a consistent brand identity and tone of voice across all channels.

Essential Skills & Experience
- Experience in a content, communications or social media marketing role, ideally B2 B.
- Excellent copywriting, editing and proofreading skills.
- Experience delivering email marketing campaigns.
- Proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud and Canva, plus photo and video editing.
- Experience with WordPress, Statamic or a similar CMS - desired, not essential
- Strong organisation, attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple deadlines.

Desirable
- Experience in construction, health and safety, training or technical B2 B sectors.
- Familiarity with Brevo or Mailchimp, SEO and marketing analytics.
- Experience coordinating exhibitions or corporate events.

Benefits
- Competitive salary (depending on experience)
- 21 days holiday + bank holidays, increasing with service
- Company pension and private healthcare
- On-site parking
- Regular team events and a supportive, collaborative culture
- Hours - Monday-Thursday 8am-4.30pm, Friday 8am-2pm

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Support Dog is an energetic, innovative national health and disability charity. We have been saving and improving the lives of children and adults affected by autism, epilepsy and disability for over 30 years. We train and provide specialist assistance dogs to achieve this

Founded and entirely based in Sheffield our charity has grown significantly over recent years. Faced with a huge demand for our services, we have recently moved to a new centre to enable us to be able to grow and help many more people. Support Dogs provides all services free of charge and relies entirely on voluntary donations for funding.

We are seeking an experienced, driven and creative Marketing Manager. As a key member of our team, you will play a pivotal role in shaping and implementing multi-channel marketing strategies that support fundraising, engage existing and new stakeholders as well as bringing our brand to life.

This is an exciting opportunity to work as a 360-marketer, at ambitious and growing charity, utilising your expertise in various channels and collaborating with stakeholders across the organisation and external agency partners.

You will lead on planning, delivering, and evaluating marketing campaigns to maximise the charity's impact and line managing our marketing team.

In return for your efforts, you will receive a competitive salary and staff benefits such as stakeholder pension scheme entitlement and private health care.

title: Retail & Brand Partnership Executive
description:
Role: Retail & Brand Partnership Executive- Sheffield

Salary: £30,000 - £35,000 per annum

Hours: 9am- 5pm Monday- Friday (flexibility)

Benefits:
- Available on request

Position Overview:

This role forms an integral part of the brand partnership and Commercialisation Team. This role will support the identification, development and delivery of income-generating opportunities, including pop-up retail, brand experiences, promotions, events, filming and experiential installations. Working under the guidance of the Commercialisation Managers, the role combines partner engagement, commercial coordination, operational delivery, compliance and performance reporting.

The role is responsible for supporting the full lifecycle of commercialisation activity, from responding to enquiries and developing proposals through to coordinating delivery, monitoring performance and maintaining accurate records. You will build effective relationships with brand partners, agencies, occupiers and internal teams, contribute to income and visitor-experience objectives, and progressively take ownership of agreed projects and accounts.
- Support the generation and conversion of commercial enquiries, preparing proposals, schedules and supporting information for prospective brand partners, pop-up retailers, promoters and agencies.
- Use social media, including LinkedIn, to raise the profile of the commercialisation team, showcase successful activations, develop industry relationships and generate new income opportunities, working within agreed brand and communications guidelines.
- Plan and maintain a pipeline of relevant social media content, collaborating with marketing colleagues and partners to source stories, imagery, case studies and commercially focused updates.
- Coordinate the end-to-end delivery of agreed activations, including site selection, documentation, approvals, operational planning, arrival, trading and departure.
- Develop strong day-to-day relationships with partners and stakeholders, providing a responsive, professional and commercially focused service.
- Ensure activity complies with centre standards, contractual requirements, health and safety procedures and relevant legislation.
- Maintain an accurate commercialisation pipeline, booking records, income data and account reconciliations, escalating risks or variances promptly.
- Use Excel to maintain and analyse commercial performance data and prepare accurate monthly management team reports, dashboards, presentations and case studies covering income, pipeline, occupancy, forecasts, social media engagement and customer feedback, highlighting trends, risks and recommended actions.
- Actively explore, adopt and share appropriate new technologies, including machine learning and automation tools, to streamline processes, improve reporting and enhance team efficiency, while following company policies on data security, governance and responsible use.
- Attend progress meetings, contribute ideas for new revenue opportunities and provide cover or support across the wider commercialisation portfolio when required.

KPI's
- Contribute to the delivery of the commercialisation business plan, including income, occupancy, visitor-experience and partner-satisfaction objectives.
- Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of relevant brands, operators, promoters and agencies, using LinkedIn and other appropriate social media channels to identify prospects, start conversations and progress opportunities in a timely manner.
- Build the team's external profile through regular, engaging social media content that demonstrates commercialisation expertise, celebrates partner success and supports lead generation.
- Deliver well-planned, safe and high-quality activations that enhance the asset and minimise disruption to customers and occupiers.
- Demonstrate sound commercial judgement in preparing proposals, monitoring agreed terms and identifying opportunities to improve income or efficiency.
- Build productive, long-term relationships with customers, occupiers, community partners and internal stakeholders.
- Support the review and performance management of appointed commercialisation, brand and marketing agencies.

Skills and competencies:
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a collaborative and customer-focused approach.
- Commercial awareness and an interest in retail, brands, events, media or experiential activity.
- Confidence using social media, particularly LinkedIn, to create engaging content and build professional networks.
- Strong numerical and analytical skills, with the ability to interpret budgets, income and performance data.
- Excellent organisation and attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines.
- Good judgement, initiative and a proactive approach to solving problems and making recommendations.
- Strong Excel skills, including formulas, pivot tables, charts and reporting, alongside proficiency in Microsoft Office.
- Curiosity and adaptability, including an interest in using emerging technology and automation to improve productivity.
- A professional and flexible approach, including occasional travel or activity outside standard working hours.

Desirable
- Experience within a retail or leisure destination.
- Event management experience.

title: Trainee Digital Marketing Manager No experience needed (Ref: 6901)
description:
DIGITAL MARKETING TRAINEESHIP (REMOTE)

Become a Digital Marketing Professional and Build Real-World Experience

Are you interested in digital marketing, online business, and helping organisations grow through effective marketing strategies? Do you want to gain practical experience while developing skills that employers are actively looking for?

We are offering a Digital Marketing Traineeship designed to help aspiring digital marketers develop industry-relevant knowledge through structured learning and practical projects.

What You Will Learn

Throughout the traineeship, you will develop an understanding of:
- Digital Marketing Fundamentals
- Marketing Strategy and Planning
- Search Engine Optimisation (SEO)
- Pay-Per-Click (PPC) Advertising
- Social Media Marketing
- Content Marketing
- Email Marketing
- Google Analytics and Marketing Analytics
- Conversion Rate Optimisation (CRO)
- Customer Journey Mapping
- Branding and Positioning
- Market Research and Competitor Analysis
- Artificial Intelligence (AI) for Marketing
- Marketing Automation
- Campaign Planning and Performance Measurement
- Marketing Reporting and Data Analysis

Practical Experience

You will work on realistic marketing projects that may include:
- Developing digital marketing strategies
- SEO audits and optimisation recommendations
- Social media campaign planning
- Content creation and marketing calendars
- Email marketing campaigns
- Marketing analytics and reporting
- Website optimisation projects
- Competitor research
- Brand positioning exercises
- Portfolio projects demonstrating your marketing skills

This practical experience will help you develop a professional portfolio that demonstrates your capabilities to future employers.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for individuals who:
- Have an interest in marketing, business, and technology
- Enjoy analysing data and solving problems
- Have good communication skills
- Are creative and eager to learn
- Can work independently and manage their time effectively
- Have basic computer skills

No previous digital marketing experience is required. Successful applicants will undertake our paid Digital Marketing training programme before progressing into employment. The cost of the training is the responsibility of the learner, and full guidance and support will be provided throughout the programme.

Benefits
- Remote and flexible learning
- Industry-relevant curriculum
- Portfolio development opportunities
- Practical project experience
- Mentoring and personalised feedback
- Career guidance and employability support
- Opportunity to develop skills sought by modern employers

Entry Requirements
- A good level of written English
- Access to a computer and internet connection
- Motivation to learn and develop professionally

Career Opportunities

Upon successful completion, learners may pursue roles such as:
- Digital Marketing Executive
- Digital Marketing Specialist
- SEO Executive
- PPC Executive
- Content Marketing Executive
- Social Media Executive
- Email Marketing Executive
- Marketing Coordinator
- Marketing Analyst
- Growth Marketing Executive
- Performance Marketing Executive
- Digital Marketing Assistant

Apply Today

If you are looking to start a career in Digital Marketing and want to gain practical experience while developing a professional portfolio, we would love to hear from you.

Submit your application today and begin your journey towards a career in one of the world's fastest-growing industries.

We advertise this role across multiple UK locations - you only need to apply once and you'll be considered for all of them.
